description: This file defines an abstract controller class 'AppController' for handling common functionalities such as auditing user actions within an ASP.NET Core web API project.

classes.name: AppController
classes.description: An abstract base controller providing auditing capabilities, accepting a database context and capturing details like IP address, user agent, and user ID for each action.

methods.name: AuditAction
methods.description: Records an audit entry capturing the action taken, subject object, and optional context details, including user info and request metadata.
